name: Suzumura Souta
source:
A cameraman by profession. He's returning to the island for his grandmother's funeral.
He lost his parents when he was very young and had to move several times, passed around among various relatives from his mother's side. Because of this, he feels an emotional attachment to the island that left him so many happy memories. He is gentle, kind, and earnest, but consequentially, there's a side of him that's not very good at relying on other people.
